candidate_indicators: Claim processing time; incomplete applications; unresolved claims
evidence_before_authorization: Confirm applicable benefit rules and document actual access barriers
authority: Unassigned programme reviewer and budget holder
eligibility_questions: Who is entitled; what documentation is proportionate; what help is available to excluded applicants
finance_formula: Approved cases times navigation unit cost plus setup and accessible communication
cost_basis: Engine anchor CAD 150 per participant; not a procurement estimate
delivery_lead_time: Measure referral to completed application and actual first receipt; compare with assessed gap date
review_and_appeal: Written reasons; accessible correction and independent review; service standard unassigned
monitoring: Receipt delay, unsuccessful applications, participant time, complaints
evaluation: Compare receipt timing and hardship against credible comparison; do not infer earnings effects
risks: Exclusion through documentation; accelerated receipt may not reduce all gap measures
exit_condition: Claim resolved or referred; review persistent barriers

candidate_indicators: Verified earnings interruption; near term essential spending gap
evidence_before_authorization: Aligned household needs and income definitions; benefit interaction review; payment feasibility
authority: Unassigned authorized funder and delivery manager
eligibility_questions: Which unit receives support; residence and programme rules; duplication; accessibility
finance_formula: Eligible recipients times weekly transfer times approved weeks plus administration and contingency
cost_basis: Engine anchor CAD 180 weekly for 12 weeks; illustrative only
delivery_lead_time: Approve only with measured payment capacity; receipt must precede anticipated gap to count as anticipatory
review_and_appeal: Explain award amount and duration; correction channel; review before termination
monitoring: Time to receipt, unmet essentials, payment failure, exclusion and repeat need
evaluation: Prespecified hardship and sustained earnings outcomes; causal comparison and benefit interaction assessment
risks: Benefit offset; unsafe data collection; unsuitable fixed amount; abrupt ending
exit_condition: Reassess need before planned end; taper or referral only under approved rules

candidate_indicators: Employer adjustment plans; reduced hours; credible threatened layoffs
evidence_before_authorization: Independent programme eligibility confirmation; business viability and worker agreement review
authority: Unassigned programme authority with employer and worker representation
eligibility_questions: Is employer eligible; which workers; hours limits; wage and benefit protections
finance_formula: Eligible worker weeks times applicable benefit plus administration, employer cost and approved training
cost_basis: Engine anchors CAD 120 administration, CAD 250 employer cost and CAD 400 training per participant; not current scheme costing
delivery_lead_time: Lead time includes employer application, agreement and payment; verify before reductions occur
review_and_appeal: Worker accessible complaint route separate from employer; programme appeal route to be confirmed
monitoring: Actual hours, earnings, exits, displacement of nonparticipants and job quality
evaluation: Estimate sustained employment and net earnings relative to eligible comparison; test deadweight
risks: Subsidizing jobs that would remain; delayed inevitable exit; employer pressure
exit_condition: Scheduled eligibility and viability review; referral when retention no longer appropriate

candidate_indicators: Destination vacancies; skill requirements; worker preferences; training completion barriers
evidence_before_authorization: Evidence of destination demand, training quality and participant ability to attend
eligibility_questions: Which skills are relevant; language access; care, transport and credential barriers
finance_formula: Participants times training and support cost plus matching and follow up
cost_basis: Engine anchors CAD 1300 training and CAD 100 worker expense; assumed acceleration is not evidence
delivery_lead_time: Measure enrolment, completion and job entry separately; provide income support if required
review_and_appeal: Choice of provider; correction of assessment; accessible complaint and withdrawal process
monitoring: Completion, job entry, sustained net earnings, hours and job quality
evaluation: Measure sustained earnings and wellbeing; compare with credible alternative; include opportunity cost
risks: Training without demand; debt or unpaid time; poor placement quality
exit_condition: Completion or informed withdrawal; follow up and alternative referral

candidate_indicators: Self reported unmet essentials; service requests; verified access barriers
evidence_before_authorization: Consent; suitable assessment; available referral capacity and eligibility
authority: Unassigned case management lead and receiving service
eligibility_questions: What needs exist now; which services are accessible; what information is necessary
finance_formula: Cases times assessment and referral cost plus interpretation and accessibility
cost_basis: No validated unit cost; obtain local costing before approval
delivery_lead_time: Measure first contact to completed service receipt; urgent current need follows appropriate response pathway
review_and_appeal: Allow correction, service choice and escalation; avoid repeated intrusive assessment
monitoring: Completed referrals, unresolved need, service refusal and participant burden
evaluation: Assess resolved needs and adverse effects; distinguish referral offered from service received
risks: Privacy loss; unavailable services; stigmatization; administrative burden
exit_condition: Confirmed resolution or documented safe handover with consent

candidate_indicators: Employment, wages, vacancies, payment delays and hardship signals with vintage labels
evidence_before_authorization: Defined coverage, data quality, revision handling and prespecified review process
authority: Unassigned analytical lead; action decisions remain with authorized programme owner
eligibility_questions: Whose data are represented; which populations are missing; permissible data use
finance_formula: Staff time plus data access, secure systems and evaluation budget
cost_basis: No approved operating budget; quote costs before commitment
delivery_lead_time: Measure source lag and decision lag against useful action window; no assumed positive lead time
review_and_appeal: Document signal challenges and corrections; no automated denial; review disputed case data
monitoring: False alarms, missed cases, lead time, missingness, differential exclusion and decision outcomes
evaluation: Prospective evaluation with frozen rules and independent outcomes before trigger validation
risks: Publication delays; spurious attribution; unrepresentative data; surveillance creep
exit_condition: Suspend an unreliable indicator; stop monitoring when purpose or lawful basis expires
